comparison.objective: Match generator frequency/phase and close a breaker at the correct synchroscope instant; the candidate performs mechanical gripper setup.
comparison.physical_skill: Instrument interpretation, repeated button input, and timing, not contact-rich two-tool manipulation.
comparison.success_condition: Speed must first be matched and the first close command issued near 12 o'clock; premature or repeated closing fails.
comparison.reason: This is a control-panel timing/procedural task with no shared physical mechanism.
